assertions.assertion: Uses ClaimMappings dictionary on SamlServiceProvider for per-SP attribute mapping
assertions.rationale: Lines 51-64 show `ClaimMappings = new Dictionary<string, string> { ... }` set directly on a `SamlServiceProvider` instance.

assertions.assertion: Explains or shows AllowedScopes as a prerequisite for claims reaching ClaimMappings
assertions.rationale: Lines 10-21 explicitly explain the claim pipeline showing AllowedScopes as step 1, and line 21 states 'ClaimMappings only renames claims that exist. If a claim type isn't in an identity resource that's in AllowedScopes, it will never reach ClaimMappings'.

assertions.assertion: Shows how to set DefaultClaimMappings on SamlOptions for global defaults
assertions.rationale: Lines 93-107 show `saml.DefaultClaimMappings = new Dictionary<string, string> { ... }` inside `.AddSaml(saml => { ... })`.

assertions.assertion: The mapping correctly associates OIDC claim names (keys) to SAML attribute URIs (values)
assertions.rationale: Lines 27-29 explicitly state the dictionary key is 'the OIDC/internal claim type name' and value is 'the SAML attribute URI the SP expects'. The code examples at lines 54-64 and 98-105 follow this pattern consistently (e.g., ["email"] = "http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/...").
